 Job Position: HR Officer (Male)

Job Location: Lekki Phase 1, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Position: Scheduler (Broadcast / Programming Scheduler)

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos

Role Summary


	The Scheduler (TV Programming) builds and manages HipTV&#39;s 24-hour broadcast schedule across DSTV and GoTV &mdash; deciding what airs when, keeping the channel filled with fresh and repeat programming, and making sure every show, news bulletin, and live special reaches air on time.

Key Responsibilities


	Build and maintain HipTV&#39;s 24-hour programming grid across DSTV (Channel 324) and GoTV (Channel 74).
	Slot new episodes, reruns, news bulletins, and special/live broadcasts (events, red-carpet coverage, The Headies) into the schedule, balancing fresh content with efficient use of off-peak hours.
	Coordinate with the Head of News Department, Editors, and production teams to confirm content is finished, approved, and delivered in time for its scheduled slot.
	Submit and maintain HipTV&#39;s Electronic Programme Guide (EPG) listings and any schedule submissions required by DSTV/GoTV (MultiChoice).
	Ensure the programming schedule complies with National Broadcasting Commission (NBC) regulations, including content classification and watershed/timing requirements.
	Manage last-minute schedule changes &mdash; breaking news interruptions, technical issues, or delayed content &mdash; with minimal disruption to the broadcast day.
	Liaise with the control room/playout team to confirm the correct content and running order are loaded and ready ahead of air time.

	Schedule on-air promos and cross-promotion for upcoming shows, events, and specials within the programming grid.
	Maintain a rolling schedule (daily, weekly, and monthly view) and communicate it clearly to all relevant teams in advance.
	Coordinate with the Facility Manager on any equipment or technical issues affecting HipTV&#39;s ability to broadcast as scheduled.


Method of Application&nbsp;

Scheduler (Broadcast / Programming Scheduler) Job at Zinajob Synergy




        
    

        
        Zinajob is an employment and recruitment platform operating in Nigeria, serving as a hub connecting  job seekers with open career opportunities across the country.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Scheduler (Broadcast / Programming Scheduler)

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Role Summary
     

            
    




	The Scheduler (TV Programming) builds and manages HipTV's 24-hour broadcast schedule across DSTV and GoTV — deciding what airs when, keeping the channel filled with fresh and repeat programming, and making sure every show, news bulletin, and live special reaches air on time.
	This role is the operational backbone of HipTV's TV channel, working closely with the Head of News Department, Editors, and the control room/playout team to keep the on-air schedule accurate, compliant, and optimised for audience reach.


Key Responsibilities


	Build and maintain HipTV's 24-hour programming grid across DSTV (Channel 324) and GoTV (Channel 74).
	Slot new episodes, reruns, news bulletins, and special/live broadcasts (events, red-carpet coverage, The Headies) into the schedule, balancing fresh content with efficient use of off-peak hours.
	Coordinate with the Head of News Department, Editors, and production teams to confirm content is finished, approved, and delivered in time for its scheduled slot.
	Submit and maintain HipTV's Electronic Programme Guide (EPG) listings and any schedule submissions required by DSTV/GoTV (MultiChoice).
	Ensure the programming schedule complies with National Broadcasting Commission (NBC) regulations, including content classification and watershed/timing requirements.
	Manage last-minute schedule changes — breaking news interruptions, technical issues, or delayed content — with minimal disruption to the broadcast day.
	Liaise with the control room/playout team to confirm the correct content and running order are loaded and ready ahead of air time.
	Track show performance data (viewership/ratings where available) and use it to inform scheduling decisions, including prime-slot placement for top-performing shows.
	Schedule on-air promos and cross-promotion for upcoming shows, events, and specials within the programming grid.
	Maintain a rolling schedule (daily, weekly, and monthly view) and communicate it clearly to all relevant teams in advance.
	Coordinate with the Facility Manager on any equipment or technical issues affecting HipTV's ability to broadcast as scheduled.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

We provide our clients - businesses and corporate organizations - across different industries with superior human capital, high-quality trainings and cutting-edge consulting to help them drive organizational growth, multiply staff productivity, gain appropriate market positioning and maximise profit.

Over the course of almost 20 years of our existence, we have serviced various organizations, many of which are strong indigenous brands operating with global standards. We are most inclined to building strong brands and supporting business growth across industries. Our preference is to work with our clients as partners on an on-going basis towards making their organizations internally effective and more profitable. As we grow into the future, the sustaining core of our operations is working with you, all the way, from People to Profit.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Site Civil Engineer

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Site Project Location: Lagos (with travel to project sites across Nigeria when required)
Reports To: Project Manager / Architect

Job Summary


	The Site Civil Engineer is responsible for the day-to-day supervision, coordination, and quality control of structural and civil engineering works on assigned projects.
	The role ensures that all construction activities are executed in accordance with approved structural drawings, engineering specifications, project programmes, quality standards, and safety requirements.
	The successful candidate will independently supervise structural works, coordinate site labour and subcontractors, monitor project progress, and ensure that projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and to the quality standards expected by the Client.
	The ideal candidate must possess strong technical knowledge of reinforced concrete construction, setting-out procedures, levelling, structural coordination, and construction methodologies for residential, commercial, and mixed-use developments.


Key Responsibilities
Structural Construction Supervision


	Supervise all structural works from foundation to roof level


Site Coordination &amp; Construction Management


	Coordinate daily construction activities with builders, architects, MEP engineers, subcontractors, artisans, and suppliers.
	Plan daily work activities to achieve programme milestones


Setting-Out, Surveying &amp; Construction Equipment

The Site Civil Engineer must be proficient in the use of construction instruments including:


	Automatic Level (Dumpy Level)
	Laser Level
	Theodolite
	Total Station (working knowledge is an advantage)
	Spirit Levels
	Plumb Bob
	Measuring Tapes
	Chalk Lines
	Straight Edges


Digital Measuring Devices Responsibilities include:


	Establishing and transferring building gridlines.
	Setting out foundations, columns, walls, roads, drainage, and external works


Quality Control:


	Conduct routine inspections of structural and civil engineering works.
	Verify reinforcement sizes, spacing, laps, anchorage lengths, and concrete cover before casting.
	Monitor concrete batching, placement, vibration, and curing.


Programme &amp; Progress Monitoring:


	Implement approved Programmes of Work.


Labour &amp; Subcontractor Management:


	Supervise artisans, subcontractors, and labour teams.


Cost &amp; Material Control:


	Monitor material usage and minimise wastage


Health, Safety &amp; Environmental Compliance:


	Enforce company HSE policies on site.


Documentation &amp; Reporting:


	Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly site progress reports.


Qualifications


	B.Sc. Degree or HND qualification in Civil Engineering.
	4&ndash;7 years of relevant post-graduate experience.
	Experience supervising reinforced concrete structures.
	Experience in residential, commercial, or mixed-use developments.
	Demonstrated ability to independently supervise structural construction works.
	Experience coordinating subcontractors and artisans.
	Practical experience using construction surveying and levelling equipment.


Salary Range
N350,000.00 - N400,000.00 per month.

Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should their CV to: jobs@pgconsultingng.com using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.",
